Priya / team — draft technical answers below that we can share with Elaine. I'll attach a retention matrix workbook with configurable values and example audit rows. Please review for legal phrasing before we send externally.

Summary (for Private deployments):
- Operational/access/auth logs: default retention 90 days; configurable 30/90/365+ days. Logs are written to customer-controlled storage in Private VPC deployments and can be routed to customer SIEM. Deletion evidence: deletion job entries are recorded in the audit log with job-id, target path, and checksum.
- Inference request metadata (request headers, model id, token counts): default retention 90 days. Full request payloads (prompt content) are not persisted by default to long-term logs in our hosted offering; for Private deployments prompts may be retained only in the in-memory KV/prefix caches unless explicitly enabled for debugging. We can configure deployments to set prompt-persistence=false so prompts are never written to disk or snapshots.
- Prompt / KV/prefix caches: by default ephemeral (24 hours TTL) in the runtime; configurable to 0 (immediate eviction) or longer (days) depending on workload. Cache contents are not included in periodic snapshot backups unless the customer enables cache inclusion; in Private installs we recommend disabling cache-inclusion for PHI workloads.
- Backup snapshots: periodic block-level snapshots (configurable cadence). Default recommended retention for Private: 180 days. Shorter windows (30/90 days) are supported and can be enforced via a lifecycle policy. Snapshots are encrypted at rest with customer-managed KMS in Private deployments. Deletion evidence for snapshots: snapshot lifecycle events are logged with snapshot-id, timestamp, and deletion_job_id.
- Evidence artifacts we can provide: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), CAIQ/SIG mapping, retention_matrix.xlsx (attached), and sample redacted deletion audit rows (CSV). For Private/on-prem we can also provide a runbook showing the snapshot purge cron job entries and corresponding audit records.

Limitations / notes for legal: we typically cannot provide raw customer data (even redacted prompts) in shared reports; deletion evidence will be redacted and show identifiers/job-ids rather than actual content. For air-gapped on-prem customers, some artifacts are generated locally and require a joint-process for evidence transfer under NDA.

I'll attach the retention matrix and an example deletion CSV. If you want, we can prepare a short addendum DPA clause that commits to default retention windows and provides tooling to assert deletion for specific objects.
